title: geranium pratense subsp. transbaicalicum
intro: Geranium pratense subsp. transbaicalicum, commonly known as the Siberian geranium or Transbaikalian crane's-bill, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Geranium pratense subsp. transbaicalicum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
